fee_notes: Royalty: 4% (traditional/Groundbreaker), 5% (Pacesetter), 6% (military/Build-to-Suit) of Gross Sales. National Advertising (WNAP): 4.0% of Gross Sales (2026-2027 per 2025 vote). Local & Regional Advertising: 0.5% baseline (co-op vote can increase). Technology Fee: $6,620-$15,000/year (~$552-$1,250/month). Cyber Insurance: ~$800/year. Customer Care: $95/month. No minimum monthly royalty stated.
